tagline: KB Kabira Skincare – Collagen Body Lotion
intro: Give your skin the nourishment it deserves with KB Collagen Body Lotion, enriched with Collagen, Ceramide, and Niacinamide. Specially formulated to deeply hydrate, firm, and rejuvenate dry skin, this lotion delivers long-lasting moisture and a smooth, supple finish.

li: Intense Hydration: Helps combat dryness and keeps skin moisturized for hours.
Firming & Tightening: Collagen boost formula supports firmer, healthier-looking skin.
Skin Barrier Support: Ceramides strengthen the skin’s natural barrier.
Brightening Care: Niacinamide improves texture and enhances natural radiance.

p: Anyone looking to achieve soft, nourished, and glowing skin with a beautifully lightweight lotion that absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky feel.

full: KB Kabira Skincare – Collagen Body Lotion
